package.description: Dual-pane file manager with a built-in terminal that follows the folder you're in.

en-US.description: Dual-pane file manager with a built-in terminal that follows the folder you're in.
en-US.longDescription:
A keyboard-driven, two-panel file manager. The built-in terminal stays in the folder you're looking at,
and if you cd somewhere in the terminal, the panel follows. Works over SSH too.

Copies and moves run in a queue in the background and pick up where they left off if the app is closed.
Deletes go to the Recycle Bin. You can copy files in cwdio and paste them in Explorer, or the other way
round.

Free during the beta. No account needed.
en-US.name: Cwdio File Manager
